project_info.theme: Lone figure beneath a desolate concrete overpass
project_info.color_palette: concrete gray, dark charcoal, white, warm highlights, muted pop blue

main_subject.type: person using an optional face reference
main_subject.detail: A lone person stands in an oversized white T-shirt and loose dark pants, hands in pockets, with a relaxed posture and natural skin texture.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: deep shadows and rich texture emphasizing the stark concrete environment

technical_specs.color_treatment: Fuji Classic Chrome-inspired grade with warm highlights, strong contrast, slight desaturation, light film grain, soft vignette, and muted pop-blue tones

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a moody urban portrait of a lone person standing under a desolate concrete overpass, with harsh architectural lines framing the figure. Dress the subject in an oversized white T-shirt and loose dark pants, hands in pockets and posture relaxed. Show rough textured concrete ground with subtle dampness. Use cinematic top lighting with deep shadows and rich texture to emphasize the starkness of the environment. Shoot as 35mm photography at f/2.8, ISO 400, 1/125 s. Apply a Fuji Classic Chrome-inspired treatment with warm highlights, strong contrast, slight desaturation, light film grain, a soft vignette, and muted pop-blue tones for a nostalgic finish.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: If supplied, preserve the face reference's facial structure, proportions, features, and expression. Preserve the oversized white T-shirt, loose dark pants, hands-in-pockets pose, desolate overpass, top lighting, and Fuji Classic Chrome mood. Do not use celebrity/public-figure likeness.

assets.name: face-reference
assets.usage: Maintain facial structure, proportions, features, and expression.
